description: Project-level settings for /canvasdemo. Registers the canvas-watcher Stop hook so Raven auto-wakes when the director hits Save on the canvas. Mirrors hooks/hooks.json which lives there for the plugin-installed flow; this file is what makes the hook fire in dev when the prototype is launched as a Claude Code project instead of via a plugin install.

hooks.rewakeMessage: Canvas update — the director just hit Save:
